name: nps_agent
description: Answers questions about U.S. National Park Services, including campgrounds, alerts, and events

skills.name: Search parks
skills.description: Search national parks by state, park code, or query.

skills.name: Get park alerts
skills.description: Get the current alerts for a specific park. Includes current weather warnings and other alerts.
examples: What are the alerts at Yellowstone?

skills.name: Get park campgrounds
skills.description: Get campground information for a park. Includes name, address, description, and number and type of campsites.
examples: What campgrounds are available at the Grand Canyon?

skills.name: Get park events
skills.description: Get upcoming events for a park. Includes date and event information.
examples: What events are coming up at Acadia?

skills.name: Get visitor centers
skills.description: Get visitor center information for a park. Includes address, operating hours, and available services.
examples: List all the visitor centers at Arches.
